title: Favorite drummers, drummers' competition, Bill Matthews
summary: Drummers competed to show each other up; he comments on Louie Coleman, Bill Matthews and Chester Jones.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who would you say was about the best drummer down there you ever heard? Did you have a favorite?
Well, I tell you, there was some pretty good one down there. No, I couldn't hardly see it this time.
Hard to pick. Hard to pick.

One or two right there. Hard to pick it. Some of them, they all used to get there and fight against one another, you know. Yeah. Yeah, like you'd be playing a job there, two or three drummers come there, and you'd better be good. Because they all come to show you up, see. And you had to play like that, only keep them from showing you up. Well, it was a hard thing to tell. Yeah. Yeah. But they had some pretty good drummers there, which they have some there now. Now, Louie Coleman, boy, he's a nice drummer, but he's not in the jazz business like we all, see. No. He's a young drummer. A little different style. Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. But we was talking about way back, the old drummers, yeah. Yeah, they had some good drummers there. Now, Bill Matthew was a good drummer when he was playing. That's right. Yeah, he was a good drummer.
Yeah, he started playing when he didn't need pants. I remember when he played the first dance on Belwyn Street.

Yeah, on Belwyn Street. He played the first dance at this Belwyn Park, they call it. And I went back there with a little bit of kid listening at him. He's playing good. And then when I did pick it up to understand he's playing good, but he gave it up and got on the trampoline. Yeah, he was a good drummer too. But they had drummers in the old age better than him. But it's been way back, I can't call any name. Now, Si, he's a good drummer. Si, he's a good drummer. Chester, he's a little late comer, him. Chester's drummer in the old age.
